description:
B-class Hunter Shin-ah's and Glitch's chaotic boss search.
Sa Baek-min, the Guild Master of the Hunter Guild "From," has gone missing in the dungeon.

Vice Guild Master Baek Shin-ah enters the dungeon, which is in the midst of its breeding season, to find him.

There, she encounters Glitch, a mysterious Incubus monster...

"I will protect you until you find that hunter. In return, give me your vital energy." To make matters worse, she is told she must soothe the boss's heat to proceed to the next floor?

The steamy boss conquest story of B-Rank Hunter Baek Shin-ah and the Incubus Monster Glitch
